commands.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh
#!/bin/sh
i=0
while true; do
  i=$((i+1))
  logger -t inventory "inventory heartbeat seq=$i host=$(hostname) ts=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
  sleep 5
done
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh

cat <<'EOF' > /etc/systemd/system/inventory.service
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Application
After=network-online.target rsyslog.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart rsyslog
sleep 1
systemctl enable --now inventory.service
sleep 1
systemctl is-active inventory.service rsyslog
